production_blockers.title: E2E Tests Fail When Run with npm test
production_blockers.description: All 13 E2E test files (*.spec.ts) fail when executed via 'npm test' because Vitest attempts to run Playwright tests, resulting in 'Playwright Test did not expect test.describe() to be called here' errors. E2E tests use Playwright's API but are being executed by Vitest instead of Playwright test runner.
production_blockers.impact: E2E test suite cannot validate end-to-end functionality, risking undetected integration bugs and business logic failures in production.

root_cause.description: Vitest configuration does not exclude E2E test files (*.spec.ts). When 'npm test' runs 'vitest run', it picks up all test files including E2E tests in tests/e2e/, which are Playwright tests incompatible with Vitest.
technical_details: Vitest runs all .test.ts and .spec.ts files by default
E2E tests import from '@playwright/test' and use test.describe(), test(), page fixtures
Playwright's test API is incompatible with Vitest's test runner
No vitest.config.ts exists to configure test file patterns
Package.json has separate commands (test vs test:e2e) but Vitest picks up both file types

fix_specification.approach: Create vitest.config.ts to exclude E2E test files from Vitest execution

files_to_create.purpose: Configure Vitest to only run unit tests, excluding E2E tests

changes_required.details: Add configuration to exclude tests/e2e/** and tests/**/*.spec.ts files

validation: Run 'npm test' and verify all unit tests pass (139 tests)
Verify no E2E test files are executed
Run 'npm run test:e2e' separately to execute Playwright tests
Verify test count matches: unit tests only via npm test

production_blockers.title: CDN Verification Test Uses Wrong Test Framework
production_blockers.description: The file tests/helpers/verify-no-cdn.test.ts uses Playwright's test API (test.describe, page fixture) but has .test.ts extension, causing Vitest to attempt execution and fail.
production_blockers.impact: CDN dependency verification test cannot run, preventing validation that the application doesn't rely on external CDN resources for accessibility testing.

root_cause.description: File uses .test.ts extension (unit test convention) but contains Playwright E2E test code with browser automation.
technical_details: File imports from '@playwright/test' but has .test.ts extension
Uses Playwright-specific features (page fixture, page.goto, page.on)
Vitest cannot execute Playwright browser automation code
Should either be moved to E2E tests or rewritten as unit test

fix_specification.approach: Rename file to .spec.ts and move to E2E test directory

changes_required.details: Rename tests/helpers/verify-no-cdn.test.ts to tests/e2e/quality/verify-no-cdn.spec.ts to match E2E test conventions
Update import of a11y.js helper to correct relative path: '../../../helpers/a11y.js'

validation: Run 'npm test' and verify file is not executed by Vitest
Run 'npm run test:e2e' and verify CDN verification test executes
Verify test passes and no CDN requests are detected

non_blockers.title: Accessibility Warnings in Components
non_blockers.description: 15 accessibility warnings found across 10 Svelte components during svelte-check. These are non-blocking but should be addressed to improve accessibility compliance.
non_blockers.impact: Reduced accessibility for users with disabilities. Does not block core functionality but affects user experience and WCAG compliance.
non_blockers.details: See a11y_warnings section below for full breakdown

warnings.message: Elements with the 'dialog' interactive role must have a tabindex value
warnings.fix: Add tabindex="-1" or tabindex="0" to the dialog div element

warnings.message: Visible, non-interactive elements with a click event must be accompanied by a keyboard event handler
warnings.fix: Add onkeydown or onkeyup handler to the backdrop div, or use a button element

warnings.message: This reference only captures the initial value of `id`. Did you mean to reference it inside a closure instead?
warnings.fix: Use $derived or move inputId generation inside a reactive statement

warnings.message: This reference only captures the initial value of `id`. Did you mean to reference it inside a closure instead?
warnings.fix: Use $derived or move selectId generation inside a reactive statement

warnings.message: This element is implicitly closed by the following `</Badge>`, which can cause an unexpected DOM structure
This reference only captures the initial value of `event`. Did you mean to reference it inside a closure instead?
warnings.fix: Use $derived or move eventInfo into a reactive statement

warnings.message: `<button>` cannot be a descendant of `<button>`. When rendering on server, HTML will be modified by browser
warnings.fix: Restructure component to avoid nested buttons - use div with onclick or separate button placement

warnings.message: Buttons and links should either contain text or have an `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or `title` attribute
warnings.fix: Add aria-label="Toggle fullscreen" to the fullscreen button

warnings.message: Buttons and links should either contain text or have an `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or `title` attribute
warnings.fix: Add aria-label="Dismiss notification" to the dismiss button

warnings.message: Buttons and links should either contain text or have an `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or `title` attribute
warnings.fix: Add aria-label="Show tooltip" or aria-label="Information" to the info button

warnings.message: A form label must be associated with a control
warnings.fix: Change <label> to <div> or <span> for read-only display fields (Username, Version, Environment)

warnings.message: A form label must be associated with a control
warnings.fix: Change <label> to <div> or <span> for Version field

warnings.message: A form label must be associated with a control
warnings.fix: Change <label> to <div> or <span> for Environment field

warnings.message: A form label must be associated with a control
warnings.fix: Add for="start-date-input" to the label and id="start-date-input" to the input element

warnings.message: A form label must be associated with a control
warnings.fix: Add for="end-date-input" to the label and id="end-date-input" to the input element
